input.free_text_description: This system is a data analytics platform that serves Candidate roles. It exposes interfaces for managing estatistica. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Candidate, I want to view reports and analytics, so that I can make informed business decisions.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Candidate, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Candidate, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
